label: Joint-absence power scope controls, by finite models (inference)
rule: Evaluate the three-world, replacement and non-Euclidean frames under the possibility reading and a maximally specific power
meaning: Nonvacuity applies actualAbsencePowerOfTotal on the three-world frame. In the replacement frame the actual contingent c is absent at true while d is contingent there, so total noncreation fails at both worlds. In the four-world non-Euclidean frame, b sees only itself, so nothing is contingent there and g (necessary) exists there; no accessible world lacks both c and d. In the three-world frame the maximally specific power holds for total noncreation (true only at none) but not for actual absence (true at some true too).
